turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Here is an example.
I work. She works.
Step: the person is "she", so I add -s. Work becomes works.
The rule: with he, she or it, the verb ends in -s.
Right: He works every day. Wrong: He work every day.

Now try this one. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
turns.judgeInput:
